lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular spots posterior to the gill slits; notable vertical alignment of three primary spots followed by a broader horizontal distribution across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical and horizontal bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect to form a lattice-like structure, with primary high-luminance blobs centered at these intersection nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A dominant linear feature running horizontally across the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical gradient with higher luminance on the dorsal side and shadow on the ventral side.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin exhibits a high-density cluster of smaller, non-grid-aligned high-luminance spots relative to the more structured pattern on the primary flank.
